doctrines.name: A: Ho-Oh sustain + Magcargo finisher
doctrines.plan: Ho-Oh active attacks Shining Feathers 160+heal every turn; Golden Flame banks 2R/turn onto one benched Magcargo; promote Magcargo only to KO a >=210HP ex or for lethal, then Melt-Away retreat back to Ho-Oh
doctrines.discriminating_metric: A/B on energy_attach_share[357] vs [356] and post_ko_attack_rate: A keeps Ho-Oh armed (Shining play_rate high, Lava periodic); B pushes energy_attach_share[356] high

doctrines.name: B: Magcargo primary beatdown
doctrines.plan: Rush loaded Magcargo active, Lava Burst repeatedly; Ho-Oh is bench-only Golden Flame battery
doctrines.discriminating_metric: compare win_rate and loss_share[deckout] between A and B; B expected to raise deckout (heavier dig to reload 5R each shot) and lower post_ko_attack_rate

tensions.balance: search/draw only while deckCount > D (D in {8,10,12,15}) AND a required piece is missing; when calibrating loss_share[deckout] also watch combo-assembly whiff to avoid bricking
bank R to exactly 5 on ONE designated benched Magcargo then stop and attack; monitor energy_attach_share[356] against nonattacking_turn_rate
fire Lava Burst only when target_eff_HP <= 70*R_on_Magcargo (secures a KO); a wasted 5-R shot is catastrophic tempo

hypotheses.claim: L0 routes energy (Golden Flame target + manual attach) to Ho-Oh (display 160) or tries type-dead Latias (display 200), starving benched Magcargo (Lava display 0), so Magcargo rarely reaches 5R and the 350 payoff never comes online
hypotheses.direction: energy_attach_share[356] must be substantial (Magcargo receives a real share of R) and play_rate[356 Lava Burst] > 0 in games where Magcargo is in play

threshold.value: energy_attach_share[356] >= 0.30 in games with Magcargo in play

hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: forcing all R to Magcargo starves Ho-Oh Shining Feathers (the sustainable per-turn attacker + heal) -> fewer attacks and total loss if the glass Magcargo dies before firing
hypotheses.scenario: Bench a Magcargo and a Ho-Oh; give hand several R. L0 attaches to Ho-Oh every turn (higher display); Magcargo stuck at 0-2 R; opponent tanks 160/turn while the 350 KO never lands.
hypotheses.violation_symptom: payoff never online / scale attack undervalued
hypotheses.pattern: promote real-damage formula to shared perception + deck-specific feeding plan (designate bench-Magcargo, cap 5)

hypotheses.claim: Unconditional draw/search (Lillie's Determination draw 6/8, Ultra Ball x4, Ethan's Adventure, Cyrano, Poke Pad, Pokegear, Fezandipiti draw 3) mills the deck to 0 and loses on the draw step; deck has no deck-refill, only Night Stretcher recycling to hand
hypotheses.direction: loss_share[deckout] must decrease well below the naive baseline
hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: throttling dig too early starves combo assembly (can't find Magcargo line or R) -> brick/whiff; must gate on 'piece missing' not deck count alone
hypotheses.scenario: Deck <= 12, hand already holds Ho-Oh + Magcargo + R; L0 still fires Lillie's Determination (draw 6) and two Ultra Balls -> deck to 0 -> lose at next turn's draw.
hypotheses.pattern: stop-digging gate at low deckCount (the stop side, not just recycle) + hold-combo gate on Lillie's

hypotheses.claim: Post-KO attack rate is low: Lava Burst self-discards all energy (0 after firing) and L0 promotes the highest-display Pokemon (Ho-Oh/benched Ho-Oh) rather than a pre-loaded attacker, so the turn after a KO often has no armed attacker
hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: pre-banking a 2nd Magcargo over-invests R and delays current damage / accelerates dig -> deckout
hypotheses.violation_symptom: main attacker KO'd then can't attack
hypotheses.pattern: 2nd Magcargo pre-bank chain (cap 5) + type-aware promotion to a loaded attacker

hypotheses.claim: Gust (Boss's Orders / Prime Catcher) is mis-gated: when Magcargo (display 0) is active it can do 350 but L0's 'gust only if active display >= 60' suppresses it; conversely gust may fire on wrong target because it can't read Lava/Cruel-Arrow real damage
hypotheses.direction: gust used on turns a real-damage KO/lethal exists (reads 70*R for Magcargo, 100 for Cruel Arrow)

threshold.value: gust converts to a KO on >= 0.7 of gust turns

hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: over-gusting burns the Supporter slot (Boss competes with draw supporters) and Prime Catcher (1 copy)
hypotheses.pattern: gust on real-damage + prize expected value

hypotheses.claim: Energy over-banking: L0 may pile more than 5 R on Magcargo or spread R across multiple Pokemon, wasting energy and delaying damage while nonattacking_turn_rate rises
hypotheses.direction: nonattacking_turn_rate must stay low; energy concentrated to cap 5 on one Magcargo
hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: capping below 5 lowers the Lava ceiling under KO thresholds (e.g. 4R=280 fails to KO a 330 ex)

hypotheses.claim: Ultra Ball (discard 2) and Lillie's Determination (shuffle hand) discard/return combo pieces: Ultra Ball can pitch the last R or a Magcargo/Ho-Oh; Lillie's can shuffle away an assembled hand
hypotheses.direction: Ultra Ball fired only with >=2 spare non-key cards; Lillie's not fired while holding assembled line
hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: refusing Ultra Ball stalls tutoring the Magcargo line
hypotheses.violation_symptom: key card to trash/deck -> win condition lost
hypotheses.pattern: state-gated discard selection (protect R + combo Pokemon) + hold-combo gate

hypotheses.claim: Buddy-Buddy Poffin x4 is a dead card: no Basic Pokemon in the deck has <=70 HP (Slugma is 80), so it whiffs 100% of plays (verified 280 plays, 0 targets); L0 wastes an item action playing it
hypotheses.direction: Poffin provides zero search value; ideally play_rate[1086] ~ 0 (do not waste the action)
hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: none — it is strictly dead; not L2-fixable beyond not playing it (does not even thin deck)

hypotheses.claim: Passivity: L0 may spend turns banking energy / digging without attacking even though Ho-Oh can Shining Feathers 160+heal nearly every turn once armed
hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: forcing an attack with an unloaded Ho-Oh (needs RRRR) wastes tempo; gate on 'armed attacker exists'

hypotheses.claim: To promote a loaded benched Magcargo, active Ho-Oh must retreat (cost 2); L0's 'do not retreat a loaded Pokemon (energy-count based)' can refuse to retreat armed Ho-Oh, stalling the Lava line (Prime Catcher self-switch is the only 1-copy bypass)
hypotheses.direction: retreat/Prime-Catcher pivot enabled on the Lava KO turn -> play_rate[356 Lava] > 0

threshold.value: on turns bench_R[356]>=5 and a KO exists, a pivot (retreat or Prime Catcher) occurs >= 0.7 of the time

hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: retreating armed Ho-Oh loses its next Shining Feathers turn; only pivot when Lava secures a KO

hypotheses.claim: Type-dead attackers treated as valid: L0 may attach R to Latias (Eon Blade display 200, needs Psychic) or Pinsir for Vise Grip (needs Grass), permanently wasting energy on Pokemon that can never fire those attacks
hypotheses.direction: energy_attach_share[184] ~ 0 (never load Latias); Pinsir loaded only for Rallying Horn CCC
hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: none — Latias never wants energy; ensure Pinsir can still receive colorless-payable R for Rallying Horn
